_help: Copy of this file is your project's single source of truth. Times are seconds on the final video timeline. Remove any optional block (hook, banner, formula, callouts, jev, music) you don't need.
title: REPLACE: working title

voice_trim.why: optional: play the source audio from `from` seconds, starting at `at` on the timeline; use it to cut a filler opener and to lengthen the intro. Captions follow.

_word_patches_help: Whisper's word pass sometimes drops the last word. Example: {"after":"using","text":"DeepSeek","start":25.6,"end":26.3}
style: REPLACE: one consistent look, e.g. dark neon, vertical 9:16, absolutely no text, letters, numbers or UI

music.prompt: calm minimal lo-fi tech beat, soft synth pad, instrumental, loopable

shots.image: REPLACE: scene prompt (no text/UI: image models invent garbled text)
shots.caption_hint: Short chip label shown at the top

hook.text: REPLACE: the question the Short answers?

callouts._help: image + aspect [w,h]; x,y,width place it on the 1080x1920 canvas; each target moves the arrow+box (arrowScale optional); several targets = arrow glides between them.

thumbnail._help: npm run thumb in remotion/ writes assets/thumbnail.jpg; shot = which generated image is the background. Keep unproven claims off it.

_jev_help: Optional custom scene: remotion/src/JevSketch.tsx is a hand-drawn diagram example. Set {"start":..,"end":..} to show it, or null to skip. Copy it as a pattern for your own diagram.
